### Introduction
This section describes the LED status indicators for our M19EV series devices.
### Diagram
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=13b0590ecc1f54dc98d5089774e20958)
##### Status Descriptions:
| Indicator | Solid On | Flashing | Off |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Power Indicator (1PWR) | Powered on; video feed normal | Powered on; video lost (camera error) | N/A |
| Positioning Indicator (2GPS) | Positioning successful | Module present; positioning failed | Module missing or faulty |
| Network Indicator (3NET) | Registered with TTX private platform | Not registered with TTX private platform | 4G/Wi-Fi module error |
| Wi-Fi Indicator (4WIFI) | 4G+AP mode | N/A | 4G+Wi-Fi mode |
| Recording Indicator (5REC) | Card present; recording in progress | Card present; not recording | Card not detected |
| Card Swipe Indicator (6RFID) | Card swipe in progress | N/A | No card swipe |
